reconcile.note: Gill distinguishes the honorific authority-title Jesus rejects from the natural use of 'father,' leaving the fifth commandment's requirement intact.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the wording directly, since the Decalogue and Paul require honoring an earthly father while Matthew has Jesus forbid calling any man father.

sides.snippet: Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
sides.verseText: \"Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

sides.snippet: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
sides.verseText: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
